title: The Last Signal
premise: A radio engineer hears a nightly message from a city that has never existed, and each answer changes a small memory she shares with her brother.
tone: Cinematic, tender, suspenseful, thoughtful; never cynical or cruel
target_audience: General audiences 13+ who enjoy meaningful short mysteries and science fiction
visual_style: Cinematic realism, midnight indigo and warm amber, 35mm texture, coherent wardrobes, no embedded text, no celebrity likenesses
world_rules: The mysterious frequency is heard only at 11:17 PM local time.
The broadcasts can alter one personal memory but cannot physically time-travel.
Every mystery clue must have a credible consequence in the same or next episode.
season_goal: Mira must determine whether recovering her brother's lost memory is worth losing her own memory of their childhood.
story_principles: Every episode has a real beginning, escalating problem, emotional reversal and meaningful partial resolution.
A cliffhanger may open a new question but must not replace the episode's payoff.
Vary the central dilemma, reveal, stakes and scene design; never repeat only a template.
Never change established world rules without a documented, plausible revelation.
